data.one_liner: Widget that animates page changes in a bottom navigation bar
data.what_it_does: Provides a BottomBarPageTransition widget that wraps page content and animates transitions between pages when the bottom navigation index changes. Supports circle, slide, and fade animations with customizable duration and curve.
use_when: You need custom page transition animations for a bottom navigation bar
You want to avoid reinitializing page widgets after a transition
You prefer a simple, declarative API without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You are using a navigation framework that already handles transitions (e.g., Navigator 2.0 with PageRouteBuilder)
You need deep link or nested navigation support
strengths: Easy to integrate with existing BottomNavigationBar
Supports multiple animation types out of the box
No extra build_runner or code generation required
weaknesses: Limited to bottom navigation bar use cases
No support for nested or deep navigation

alternatives.name: page_transition
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides generic page transitions that can be used in any navigation context
